drowned_bell.title: The Drowned Bell
drowned_bell.summary: (EXAMPLE QUEST) The gatehouse bell has not rung in years. Ring it to warn the village — if the gatehouse will let you.

objectives.text: Speak with Miruna at the gatehouse.
Recover the bell clapper from the flooded stores.
Face or parley with the thing in the crypt.

lightbringers.title: The Lightbringers
lightbringers.summary: (SOURCE-ADAPTED QUEST) Ashlyn and her companions came to Barovia to fight the dead. Help her hold the town square, then learn what happened at the church.

objectives.text: Help Ashlyn hold the town square.
Speak with Ashlyn after the battle.
